content:
You’ll find this post in your _posts directory. Go ahead and edit it and re-build the site to see your changes. You can rebuild the site in many different ways, but the most common way is to run jekyll serve, which launches a web server and auto-regenerates your site when a file is updated.

Jekyll requires blog post files to be named according to the following format:

YEAR-MONTH-DAY-title.MARKUP

Where YEAR is a four-digit number, MONTH and DAY are both two-digit numbers, and MARKUP is the file extension representing the format used in the file. After that, include the necessary front matter. Take a look at the source for this post to get an idea about how it works.

Jekyll also offers powerful support for code snippets:

def print_hi(name)
  puts "Hi, #{name}"
end
print_hi('Tom')
#=> prints 'Hi, Tom' to STDOUT.

Check out the Jekyll docs for more info on how to get the most out of Jekyll. File all bugs/feature requests at Jekyll’s GitHub repo. If you have questions, you can ask them on Jekyll Talk.

title: About Me
content:
I’m a data analyst and software professional interested in how complex systems behave, how data reveals hidden patterns, and how AI models adapt to different tasks. I enjoy work that requires investigation, structured thinking, and breaking down messy problems into something understandable and actionable.

My independent study on modern AI reinforced that interest. I explored language model architectures, fine-tuning methods, and narrative behavior, and the project gave me a deeper appreciation for how these systems learn and generalize. It’s an area I plan to continue developing in both personal research and professional work.

Outside of data and AI, I spend my time gaming, reading, watching anime, and running. Track was a big part of my life in college, and while competition is behind me, staying active is still something I prioritize.

title: Projects
content:
PowerScaleDB Web App
A Flask-based web application for structuring, storing, and analyzing power-scaling data for fictional characters across multiple verses. PowerScaleDB models attributes such as Attack Potency, Speed, Durability, and Hax using a relational schema.

It replaces fragmented spreadsheets and subjective wikis with a consistent data model that supports ranking, comparison, and future analytics.



Demystifying AI: A Guide to LLMs
A research-driven independent study completed during my senior year. I explored modern language model architecture, in-context learning, fine-tuning techniques, and AI ethics.

The project culminated in fine-tuning a model on Grimm’s Fairy Tales and comparing its outputs to baseline models using structured text analysis and zero-shot prompting.



Aquaculture Simulation
A simulation of a closed-loop aquarium ecosystem.

The model represents fish growth, plant development, and nitrogen cycling, allowing exploration of conditions required for a balanced, self-sustaining environment.



D3 Track Analysis
A statistical examination of NCAA Division III men’s track performances from the 2023 season.

The analysis includes regression modeling to study relationships between event times (100m–200m and 200m–400m) and evaluates variance across regional competitive tiers.
